system.description: You know how to survive in unpeopled lands. After spending at least ten minutes in the wilderness and succeeding on a difficulty 2 outdoor survival task (or a difficulty your GM determines is appropriate to the area), you find something useful you were seeking. The useful thing might be shelter in the form of a cave or tree hollow, all the makings necessary to start a fire, a game animal you bring down with ease, or berries, mushrooms, root vegetables, or other food. You know how to best prepare any game or vegetation you find and are able to feed yourself and up to five allies.
